'''Alben-Bal''' was a [[Voss (species)|Voss]] administrator who lived on [[Voss]] after the [[Eternal Empire conquest]]. He founded the [[Shrine Restoration Initiative]] along with the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] leader [[Kijak]], despite many doubting his plan.<ref name="Shrine Restoration Initiative"/>
